gizmo.title: Isigcawu sesimo
gizmo.description: Isigcawu esisodwa sesimo esinamagatsha. Xhuma ukukhetha ngakunye nesinye isigcawu nge-# elandelwa i-ID yaso yesigcawu.

configure.title: I-ID yesigcawu
configure.description: Lokho ukukhetha okuxhuma kukho: isixhumanisi ku-# esilandelwa yile id siholela kulesi sigcawu. Izinhlamvu, izinombolo namahayifeni.

configure.title: Isiphetho
configure.description: Ukuthi lesi sigcawu siqeda indlela yini, nokuthi kuphume kanjani.

configure.title: Amaphuzu
configure.description: Amaphuzu okufinyelela kulesi siphetho. Amaphuzu aphezulu kakhulu esiphetho esimweni ayisamba esiphezulu.
